---
title: "Imaging — data and imputation"
format: html
---

- Counts and exposure cover the first 182 days; exposure ends at death or censoring.

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(mice)
library(arrow)
library(here)
library(knitr)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "09-imaging", "results")
imputation_path <- file.path(results_dir, "imputation.rds")
completed_path <- file.path(results_dir, "completed-datasets.rds")

dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Data

```{r}
#| label: imaging-data

cohort <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet")
)

imaging_data <- cohort |>
  mutate(
    exposure_days = survival_time_days,
    ecog_group = case_when(
      ecog_fstcnt >= 3 ~ "3+",
      .default = as.character(ecog_fstcnt)
    ),
    ecog_group = factor(
      ecog_group,
      levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3+"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    id,
    tx,
    n_imaging_total,
    n_imaging_ct,
    n_imaging_mri,
    n_imaging_pet_ct,
    exposure_days,
    age,
    ecog_group
  )

stopifnot(!anyNA(imaging_data$n_imaging_total))
```

```{r}
#| label: exclude-zero-exposure

n_zero_exposure <- sum(imaging_data$exposure_days == 0)

# Zero follow-up means no time at risk, so no rate: excluded.
imaging_data <- imaging_data |>
  filter(exposure_days > 0)

write_parquet(
  imaging_data,
  file.path(results_dir, "analysis-data.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)

n_zero_exposure
```

## Descriptive summary

```{r}
#| label: tbl-imaging-descriptive
#| tbl-cap: "Imaging examinations by randomized group"

descriptive_summary <- imaging_data |>
  mutate(group = if_else(tx == 1, "ctDNA", "Usual care")) |>
  summarise(
    patients = n(),
    patients_imaged = sum(n_imaging_total > 0),
    ct = sum(n_imaging_ct),
    mri = sum(n_imaging_mri),
    pet_ct = sum(n_imaging_pet_ct),
    total = sum(n_imaging_total),
    exposure_days = sum(exposure_days),
    .by = group
  ) |>
  mutate(n_excluded_zero_exposure = n_zero_exposure)

write_parquet(
  descriptive_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "descriptive-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)

kable(descriptive_summary)
```

## Imputation of baseline covariates

```{r}
#| label: missing-covariates

imaging_data |>
  summarise(across(c(age, ecog_group), \(x) sum(is.na(x))))
```

```{r}
#| label: impute-covariates

# Column order sets the mice visit sequence; keep it.
imputation_data <- imaging_data |>
  mutate(log_exposure = log(exposure_days)) |>
  select(tx, n_imaging_total, log_exposure, age, ecog_group)

methods <- make.method(imputation_data)
methods[] <- ""
methods["ecog_group"] <- "polr"

if (!file.exists(imputation_path)) {
  imputation <- mice(
    imputation_data,
    method = methods,
    m = config$imputation$m_supporting,
    maxit = config$imputation$maxit,
    donors = config$imputation$donors,
    seed = config$seeds$supporting + 2600L,
    printFlag = FALSE
  )

  saveRDS(imputation, imputation_path, compress = "xz")
}

imputation <- readRDS(imputation_path)

c(m = imputation$m, iterations = imputation$iteration)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-imputation-traces
#| fig-cap: "MICE trace plots for imputed ECOG"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 3

plot_mice_traces(mice_chain_stats(imputation))
```

## Completed datasets

```{r}
#| label: completed-datasets

completed_datasets <- complete(imputation, action = "all") |>
  map(\(data) {
    data |>
      mutate(
        exposure_days = exp(log_exposure),
        ecog_group = factor(ecog_group, ordered = FALSE)
      ) |>
      select(-log_exposure)
  })

saveRDS(completed_datasets, completed_path, compress = "xz")
```
